title: Order-update stream status (NOT market-data health)
description: Source: src/box/orderStreamStatus.ts orderStreamStatus(). Answers one operator question: is the fast fill path running, or are fills observed by REST polling? A healthy market-data socket is NOT evidence of a working order-update stream: Zerodha sends order updates as TEXT frames on the same socket that carries binary ticks, and Dhan uses a separate order-update WebSocket. Carries no token, account id or secret.

any_stream_live.description: True only when at least one broker's order stream is genuinely delivering updates. False whenever fills depend on REST polling.

market_data_health_is_not_order_stream_h.description: Explicit anti-conflation flag. The UI MUST NOT present a healthy market-data feed as evidence that fills are observed promptly.

wiring.description: not_built = no implementation. not_wired = implemented and unit-tested but NO running component consumes it, so it cannot deliver a fill (this is NOT 'disabled by choice'). gated_off = wired but the env gate is not armed. armed = gate on; the health field then decides.

gate_env_var.description: Name of the env switch, so an operator can find it. NAME only, never a value.

health.description: Live projection health, or null when nothing consumes the stream.

state.description: RECONNECTED_PENDING_RECONCILE mandates a REST reconciliation before the stream is trusted again; the gap must be repaired, never assumed empty.

fills_observed_by.description: The mechanism CURRENTLY responsible for observing a fill. rest_polling_only means fill-observation latency is bounded by the polling cadence and the pacing floor, not by broker push latency.
